name: northcinder
description: Advanced NorthCinder MCP client for a separately operated authenticated engine, with buyer-criteria ranking, exact-purchase approval, watches, and a local audit trail.
long_description: This bundle is the advanced client for a NorthCinder engine you operate separately. It is not the ordinary one-process local setup from npx northcinder init. NorthCinder ranks disclosed offers by buyer criteria, keeps sponsored offers below organic results, and requires explicit human confirmation for each exact purchase. Approval material is stored in the buyer's local account. An AI application granted file access as the same OS user may be able to read it; separate OS accounts are an optional isolation boundary.

serviceUrl.title: Your NorthCinder engine URL
serviceUrl.description: HTTPS base URL of the separately operated NorthCinder engine you control. Explicit loopback HTTP is also allowed. The repository owner operates no endpoint.

clientKey.title: Your NorthCinder engine key
clientKey.description: Buyer-generated Bearer key for your NorthCinder engine (at least 16 characters). This is not an AI model-provider token.

configDir.title: Local config directory
configDir.description: Where the mandate keypair, audit log, watches, orders, and profile are stored (0600, local-only). Defaults to your OS config directory.
